case.summary: This alert was triggered by a customer message stating 'I never made this $236.28 purchase. Please check my card.' regarding transaction 3660350 on card C09582-K1. Graph evidence shows a clear card testing pattern, with four online authorizations under $5 occurring within an hour before the flagged $236.28 online purchase. Additionally, this card is almost exclusively used in person, with only 5 of 708 prior transactions occurring online. The final verdict is fraud with a 0.97 probability, and the case is closed as fraud. The final actions include automatically creating a case and recommending a card block awaiting L1 human approval, with no suspicious activity report recommended.
